title: Concept: Dependency pinned to the latest dist-tag
description: package.json declares a dependency pinned to the `latest` dist-tag instead of a version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The tag moves whenever the publisher releases, so a build resolves a different version than the one that was reviewed and tested.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The tag moves whenever the publisher releases, so a build resolves a different version than the one that was reviewed and tested.
